description.html: This 100x45x45 cm glass terrarium with a volume of 202.5 liters is made from glass of the right thickness for its size. The outer sides are covered with decorative film you choose when ordering: wood, bamboo, marble, black or white.

A length of 100 cm and a width of 45 cm provide a large floor area for ground-dwelling species. The floor dimensions allow a basking spot at one end and a cooler hide at the other. Mesh covers on the ventilation openings let air through but not food or the small inhabitants of the terrarium.

We offer full customization: you choose the film, background and ventilation, plus optional LED lighting or a thermostat. If this model doesn't fit your space, we build terrariums in any dimensions. Call for a quote.
